CP25-514-000 [Mississippi Crossing/MSX] and CP25-517-000 [SSE4] jointly noticed). The independent watchdog oilandgaswatch.org also covers it (2024) as a real FERC application. Correctly classified as gas transmission -- SNG and Elba Express are FERC-regulated interstate natural gas transmission companies per their own project FAQ. No duplicate: no other row in the 44-pipeline roster shares this project's termini, docket, or operator combination (P7802 Tennessee Gas Pipeline/MSX and P7841 Mississippi Crossing Project are a DIFFERENT, though FERC-docket-adjacent, project on a different pipeline system -- see cross_row_leads). (SNG). Recommend reconciling via entity_lookup.py before pasting, since the dropped 'Company' could create a duplicate entity distinct from GEM's existing Southern Natural Gas Company record. ROUTE NOTE: the digitized route (14 features, 1,038 pts) runs from the MS/AL line about 10 mi ESE of Meridian, MS (near Clarke County, the westernmost receipt point named in KMI's fact sheet) to a point roughly 10-15 mi WSW of Augusta, GA (Georgia side of the Savannah River, in the Waynesboro/Augusta vicinity). This accurately traces the SNG South Main Line looping (the 291-mi, MS-AL-GA physical pipe both KMI and the independent watchdog oilandgaswatch.org describe -- oilandgaswatch explicitly scopes the pipe to 'Georgia, Alabama, and eastern Mississippi', no South Carolina). The route is judged ACCURATE for the new pipe it depicts; it does not extend into South Carolina because no new linear pipe is built there.

cross_row_leads.facts: Tennessee Gas Pipeline's Mississippi Crossing Project (MSX), docket CP25-514-000, received its FERC certificate order the SAME DAY as SSE4 (2026-07-31), in the same combined proceeding (Federal Register 91 FR 39992 notices both CP25-514-000 and CP25-517-000 together). MSX: ~208 mi new pipeline + laterals in MS/AL, 3 new compressor stations, 4 new meter stations, ~$1.7 billion, 2.06 million Dth/d (~2,060 MMcf/d), 93% of capacity under long-term precedent agreements. Interconnects with SSE4/Elba Express but is a legally and physically separate project (different applicant, Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co., not Southern Natural Gas).

Same MSX facts as filed against P7802 above -- confirms P7802 and P7841 both describe the identical Tennessee Gas Pipeline Mississippi Crossing Project (CP25-514-000, certificate order 2026-07-31, ~208 mi, ~$1.7B, 2.06 million Dth/d, 93% contracted). Strengthens the roster note that P7802 and P7841 are the same project filed twice.
